page.overview:
Who is Scopper Gaban?

Scopper Gaban, also known as the "Mountain-Eater", is a legendary retired pirate and navigator of the former Roger Pirates. His fame is said to rival that of his crewmates Gol D. Roger and Silvers Rayleigh, being known as the "Left Hand of the Pirate King". After the disbandment of the Roger Pirates and the execution of Roger, Gaban has come to live out his retirement on Elbaph, alongside his partner Ripley and their son Colon, being known to the giant locals as Ya-san.

First introduced in Buggy's flashback sequence in the Orange Town Arc and later seen in Kouzuki Oden's flashbacks during his time with the Roger Pirates, Gaban made his present-day debut in the series through the "From the Decks of the World" cover story, before eventually playing an active role in the main storyline during the Elbaph Arc where he acts as an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates.

Gaban is a man with wild white hair tied in a bushy ponytail and a wrinkled face as a result of his advanced age. He sports a long beard that is braided at the chin, a flame-shaped scar over his right eye, and a pair of round, black sunglasses. His outfit consists of a red Hawaiian shirt with yellow and orange flower patterns, brown shorts, and black boots, which are complemented by a , and a purple and black-striped coat whenever he is on the move. In his battle against Nerona Imu, Gaban's left arm was sliced off.

In the past, Gaban was a tall, well-built man with long black hair, with two thin strands of hair falling over his face (which he no longer has in the present). 27 years ago, he wore a long-sleeved blue shirt with white stripes on each sleeve, which was only held closed at the middle with one button. In the anime, he was initially depicted in this outfit with lighter-colored hair, silver sunglasses, and a purple shirt with a yellow stripe on the collar and down each arm. 26 years ago, he initially wore a yellow t-shirt with two orange blotch-like patterns on the right side, blue pants, and a purple sash. He then wore a purple shirt, orange pants, and a pale-yellow sash.
